name: RefineGuard APM
elevator_pitch: In modern petroleum refining, an unexpected pump or compressor trip can trigger flaring, production curtailments, or catastrophic seal blowouts costing millions of dollars per day. RefineGuard APM is an industrial-grade, strictly on-premises predictive maintenance and asset performance platform engineered specifically for critical refinery rotating machinery. Operating entirely within air-gapped Purdue Model Level 3/3.5 OT networks, RefineGuard ingests high-frequency process and vibration telemetry directly from OSIsoft PI and Honeywell PHD historians, running multivariate anomaly detection and physics-informed failure mode diagnostics to detect mechanical degradation 14 to 30 days before functional failure. By eliminating cloud dependencies while slashing false alarms by over 60%, RefineGuard empowers reliability teams to extend MTBF, avert uncontained hydrocarbon releases, and shift from reactive firefights to high-confidence prescriptive maintenance.
problem_statement:
Refineries operate under intense operational pressure, where thousands of rotating machinery assets—including multi-stage centrifugal feed pumps, catalytic cracking wet gas compressors, hydrogen make-up reciprocating compressors, and steam turbine drivers—run continuously under extreme pressures, temperatures, and corrosive hydrocarbon environments. Today's operations suffer from critical vulnerabilities:

1. Catastrophic Mechanical Failures: Sudden mechanical seal blowouts, bearing cage disintegrations, and impeller rubs frequently result in immediate unit shutdowns, dangerous hydrocarbon vapor leaks, emergency flaring, and OSHA/EPA compliance violations costing $1M-$5M per incident in lost gross margins and maintenance overhaul.
2. Ineffective Time-Based and Route-Based Maintenance: Plants rely heavily on manual handheld vibration routes performed every 30 to 60 days, leaving wide blind spots where rapid degradation occurs unmonitored. Conversely, premature overhaul of healthy assets introduces secondary maintenance-induced failure risks and inflated turnaround costs.
3. Severe SCADA/Historian Alarm Fatigue: Control room DCS and historian threshold alarms only trigger once parameters (such as vibration velocity or bearing metal temperature) breach high-high static trip points, leaving operators with minutes rather than weeks to intervene before emergency shutdowns.
4. The Cloud SaaS Impasse: While modern machine learning APM exists in commercial cloud ecosystems, strict refinery cybersecurity frameworks (Purdue Model Level 3/3.5 DMZ, IEC 62443, NIS2) strictly forbid streaming raw process and operational telemetry to external cloud servers. Refineries are left stranded without modern predictive AI because standard SaaS tools cannot operate within air-gapped, zero-outbound-internet architectures.
solution:
RefineGuard APM delivers a zero-cloud, fully autonomous on-premises Asset Performance Management platform deployed inside the refinery's OT/IT Level 3/3.5 perimeter. It bridges plant historians with cutting-edge machine learning and deterministic machinery diagnostics:

1. High-Throughput On-Prem Data Connectors: Natively integrates with OSIsoft PI System / AVEVA PI AF, Honeywell PHD, and Yokogawa Exaquantum historians via OPC UA, native SDKs, and REST/AF SDK without modifying DCS controls or introducing network latency.
2. Multivariate Asset Health Index: Combines high-frequency vibration spectrums, bearing/winding temperatures, motor current signatures, lube oil differential pressures, suction/discharge pressures, and seal buffer pressures into a unified dynamic Asset Health Index (0-100) aligned with ISO 10816-3/7 and ISO 14224 failure taxonomy.
3. Unsupervised & Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection: Employs autoencoders, principal component analysis, and dynamic time warping calibrated against clean baseline operating regimes (accounting for process swings, feed gravity changes, and throughput variations) to pinpoint micro-deviations 14-30 days before threshold exceedance.
4. Diagnostic Classifier & Failure Mode Fingerprinting: Identifies specific failure mechanisms—including cavitation, unbalance, angular misalignment, bearing inner/outer race spalling, seal flush degradation, and impeller blade pass defects—distinguishing between process anomalies and mechanical distress.
5. Remaining Useful Life (RUL) & Prescriptive Action: Calculates prognostic degradation trajectories and estimates time-to-functional-failure, automatically prescribing operational throttles and generating maintenance work-order payloads ready for export into enterprise CMMS/EAM systems (SAP PM, IBM Maximo).
vision:
RefineGuard APM's long-term vision is to transform oil refinery rotating equipment operations from reactive condition monitoring into a fully autonomous, closed-loop Asset Performance Ecosystem. 

Over the next 3 to 5 years, RefineGuard will evolve to:
1. Autonomous Operational Optimization: Move beyond advisory alerting to closed-loop DCS communication, where safe operating envelopes are dynamically negotiated with Advanced Process Control (APC) systems to automatically de-stress degraded machinery while preserving refinery throughput.
2. Federated Enterprise Fleet Intelligence: Enable multi-refinery operators to share anonymized, fleet-wide failure models and degradation physics across decentralized air-gapped sites via privacy-preserving federated learning—without moving raw operational data outside site boundaries.
3. Full Lifecycle Digital Twins: Integrate engineering design data, 3D spatial models, acoustic sensor telemetry, and lubricant lab spectroscopy into an all-encompassing machinery digital twin that optimizes turnaround intervals, capital spare parts holding, and total cost of ownership across decades of refinery operations.
competitors:
1. GE Vernova / Bently Nevada System 1:
- Comparison: System 1 is an industry-standard online condition monitoring system widely deployed for turbomachinery protection and rack-based vibration diagnostics.
- Differentiation: While System 1 excels at API 670 machinery protection and specialized vibration rack analysis, it is notoriously complex, expensive to scale across general balance-of-plant (BOP) pumps and motors, and lacks modern multivariate anomaly detection that merges process telemetry (temperatures, flow, pressure) with vibration. RefineGuard APM offers intuitive multivariate AI, covers both critical turbomachinery and fleet-wide BOP assets, and integrates seamlessly without requiring proprietary edge hardware.

2. AspenTech Mtell:
- Comparison: Mtell provides agent-based pattern recognition for industrial equipment and operates on-premises.
- Differentiation: Mtell requires laborious configuration of 'failure agents' and 'normal agents' for every machine, leading to high professional services overhead and brittle models that break when process conditions shift. RefineGuard APM uses self-calibrating unsupervised multivariate autoencoders combined with ISO 14224/10816 machinery physics heuristics, drastically shortening time-to-value without manual agent programming.

3. AVEVA Predictive Analytics (formerly PRiSM):
- Comparison: Leading APM platform using empirical similarity modeling (ESM) that integrates with OSIsoft PI.
- Differentiation: AVEVA Predictive Analytics relies heavily on legacy ESM algorithms that struggle with non-linear transient states and complex rotating vibration harmonics. Furthermore, AVEVA's modern roadmap is aggressively shifting toward cloud SaaS (AVEVA Connect), which conflicts with air-gapped refinery OT policies. RefineGuard is built ground-up for high-frequency spectral analytics and committed to a pure on-premises, air-gapped lifecycle.

4. Uptake / Baker Hughes Cordant:
- Comparison: Cloud-native enterprise AI APM offerings.
- Differentiation: Uptake and Cordant depend heavily on multi-tenant cloud infrastructure and outbound cloud data gateways. Because oil refinery OT security strictly enforces Purdue Level 3 isolation and prohibits cloud connectivity, these solutions are non-viable or require extreme compliance exceptions. RefineGuard operates natively on local bare-metal or private cluster hardware with zero cloud dependencies.
success_metrics:
1. Unplanned Downtime Reduction: Achieve a 25% to 40% reduction in rotating equipment-related unplanned unit shutdowns, slowdowns, and flaring incidents within 12 months of deployment.
2. Advance Warning Lead Time (MTTD): Deliver early anomaly warnings 14 to 30 days prior to functional equipment failure, expanding the operational P-F interval to enable planned turnarounds.
3. False Alarm Suppression: Decrease false positive machinery alerts by >=60% compared to legacy DCS/historian static threshold alarms, restoring engineer trust.
4. Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Extension: Increase rotating equipment MTBF across monitored units by 20% to 35% through early defect remediation and vibration harm prevention.
5. Maintenance Cost Savings: Reduce emergency maintenance spend and reactive overtime repairs by 30%, saving an estimated $1.8M to $4.5M annually for a typical 250,000 BPD refinery.
6. Zero Cloud / Security Compliance: Maintain 100% on-premises operational continuity with zero outbound internet network packets, achieving 100% compliance with IEC 62443 Level 3 cybersecurity audits.
design_principles:
### 1. High-Density Data Architecture with Progressive Disclosure
RefineGuard APM operates in 24/7 mission-critical petrochemical control rooms and reliability engineering workspaces where seconds matter. The interface maximizes operational situational awareness through compact, information-dense visual layouts that aggregate hundreds of historian tags into coherent asset representations. Key telemetry (overall RMS velocity, peak-to-peak displacement, bearing temperatures, discharge pressures, motor current) is visible at a glance without decorative whitespace or gratuitous padding. Deep analytical detail (FFT spectral charts, harmonic sidebands, Nyquist/Bode plots, and fault frequency markers) is progressively disclosed via structured drill-downs and docked analytical drawers, preventing cognitive overload during upset conditions.

### 2. ISO 10816 & Petrochemical Telemetry Color Semantics (Strict 4-State Chroma)
Colors convey operational severity with strict adherence to industrial standards (ISO 10816-3/7 and API 670 machinery vibration states). Color is never used purely for decoration. Visual states are rigorously mapped:
- **Normal / Healthy (ISO Zone A/B):** Desaturated Emerald Green (`#10B981` / Dark token `#059669`). Stable baseline operation within permissible limits.
- **Alert / Degraded (ISO Zone C - Advisory):** Muted Amber/Yellow (`#F59E0B` / Dark token `#D97706`). Long-term degradation requiring engineering review; non-imminent intervention.
- **Alarm / Restricted (ISO Zone D - High):** High-Chroma Orange (`#F97316` / Dark token `#EA580C`). Actionable machine distress requiring planned operational derate or maintenance within 14-30 days.
- **Trip / Critical (ISO Zone D - Severe/Shutdown):** Vivid Vermilion Red (`#EF4444` / Dark token `#DC2626`). Imminent failure threshold with hazard of catastrophic trip; immediate mitigation required.
All colored states are accompanied by redundant shape, text, and iconography cues (ISO 7000 symbols) to maintain 100% clarity for colorblind operators and high-stress glare conditions.

### 3. Control-Room Dark Mode & 24/7 Ergonomic Visual Budget
Engineered natively for low-ambient illumination refinery DCS console rooms and dual/quad-monitor engineering benches. The default interface is an ergonomic deep neutral slate dark mode (base `#0F172A`, surface `#1E293B`, elevation border `#334155`), eliminating retinal fatigue and glare during 12-hour rotating shift cycles. Contrast ratios exceed WCAG AAA standards (7:1 minimum for data labels and numeric readings, 4.5:1 for structural hierarchy). A high-contrast light mode (`#F8FAFC`) is provided for sunlit field trailer inspections and office reporting environments.

### 4. Explainable Diagnostics & Deterministic Cues (No "Black-Box" Alerts)
Machine learning anomaly scores and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) projections must be deterministic, transparent, and defensible to vibration specialists and operations superintendents. Every health index degradation or diagnostic alert explicitly displays its root-cause telemetry drivers (e.g., "78% attribution to Outboard Bearing 1X harmonic amplitude surge; 22% attribution to DE Bearing RTD thermal drift"). Probabilistic predictions are paired with physical failure mechanism fingerprints (e.g., ISO 13373-3 bearing ball-pass frequencies: BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF) and confidence intervals.

### 5. Keyboard-Centric Ergonomics & Rapid Triage Efficiency
Engineered for rapid keyboard-only navigation during high-stress operational reviews and shift handovers. Operators and engineers can execute multi-step workflows without touching the mouse: global asset quick-switcher (`Cmd/Ctrl + K`), unit filtering (`1`-`4`), alert acknowledgment (`Space` / `A`), spectral cursor harmonic snapping (`H`), waterfall timeline scrub (`[` / `]`), and CMMS work order generation (`Cmd/Ctrl + Enter`). Focus rings are prominent and unmistakable.

### 6. Air-Gapped Resiliency & Deterministic State Reflection
Designed specifically for OT/IT Purdue Model Level 3/3.5 air-gapped refinery networks. The interface provides continuous, prominent local telemetry connection indicators (OSIsoft PI AF and Honeywell PHD polling latency, local buffer depths, and synchronization health). All offline transitions, local cache states, and batch historian backfills are deterministically reflected in the UI header, ensuring operators never act on stale or desynchronized data.

navigation_design:
### 1. Global Layout Architecture

RefineGuard APM implements a high-density, low-latency layout engineered for multi-monitor industrial engineering benches and DCS control room displays. The layout consists of four persistent structural zones:

```
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Persistent Top Application Header (Status, Air-Gap Telemetry, Quick Switcher, Alert Drawer, User)      |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Collapsible Left  | Contextual Breadcrumb & Scope Navigation                                                |
| ISA-95 Hierarchy  +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Navigation Tree   | Asset Context Tab Bar (Health Summary | Diagnostics | Spectral Analytics)               |
|                   +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                   | Primary High-Density Workspace Area                                                  |
|                   |                                                                                      |
|                   |                                                                                      |
+-------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Global Status Footer (Historian Sync Latency: 420ms | Local DB: Healthy | Active Buffer: 0 KB | Rev 3.2.1)   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Persistent Top Header & Air-Gapped Health Badges

The 52px high top header remains anchored across all application states, providing global situational context and rapid utility controls:
- **Product Brand & Refinery Facility Selector:** Displays "RefineGuard APM" alongside current refinery facility identifier (e.g., "Baton Rouge Refinery - Zone 1").
- **Air-Gapped Ingestion Telemetry Badges:**
  - *OSIsoft PI AF Status:* Live connection dot (Green `#10B981` / Flashing Amber `#F59E0B`), ingestion latency in milliseconds (e.g., `PI: 380ms`), and polling buffer state.
  - *Honeywell PHD Status:* Live state pill indicator (e.g., `PHD: Sync OK`).
  - *Air-Gap Governance Badge:* Shield indicator denoting "Local OT Air-Gap Sealed - Outbound Blocked".
- **Global Asset & Tag Quick Switcher (`Cmd/Ctrl + K`):** Omnibox search modal enabling immediate fuzzy-search access to any plant asset tag, equipment number (e.g., `P-101A`, `K-201`), or historian sensor tag (`101_VIB_OB_R`).
- **Global Alert & Advisory Drawer Trigger:** Bell icon with live counter badge showing active ISO Alarm (`4`) and Trip (`1`) conditions. Clicking expands a right-side docked triage flyout.
- **Role & Profile Menu:** Displays logged-in operator name, current active application role (`reliability_engineer`, `machinery_specialist`, etc.), local domain identifier, and sign-out action.

---

### 3. Collapsible Left Navigation (ISA-95 Hierarchy Browser)

A 280px wide collapsible sidebar supporting dual navigation modes:

#### A. Primary Module Navigation Links
- **Fleet Overview** (`/fleet-overview`) — Global asset triage matrix
- **Asset Hierarchy** (`/assets`) — Deep ISA-95 equipment navigation
- **Prescriptive Advisories** (`/prescriptive-advisories`) — RUL, recommendations, and CMMS dispatch
- **Operations Risk Matrix** (`/operations/unit-risk-matrix`) — Plant throughput risk & shift log
- **Model Management** (`/model-management/retraining`) — Baseline training & evaluation
- **System Administration** (`/admin/historian-connections`) — Connectors, tag mapping, security audit

#### B. Hierarchical Plant Tree (ISA-95 & ISO 14224)
Collapsible accordion tree browser structured strictly by refinery topology:
- **Refinery Complex**
  - **Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-1)**
    - Crude Feed Pumping Train
      - `P-101A` — Crude Charge Pump A *(Pill: ISO Alarm / Orange)*
      - `P-101B` — Crude Charge Pump B *(Pill: ISO Normal / Green)*
      - `M-101A` — Primary Electric Driver
    - Atmospheric Fractionator Reflux Train
      - `P-104A/B` — Column Overhead Reflux Pumps
  - **Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCCU)**
    - Main Air Blower Train
      - `C-201` — FCC Multi-Stage Axial Air Compressor *(Pill: Normal)*
      - `T-201` — Gas Expansion Driver Turbine
    - Wet Gas Compression Train
      - `K-201` — Two-Stage Wet Gas Centrifugal Compressor
  - **Hydrocracker Complex (HCU)**
    - Reactor Recycle Gas Compression
      - `K-301A/B` — High-Pressure Recycle Gas Compressor Trains
  - **Alkylation & Acid Plant (ALKY)**
    - Depropanizer Circulation Pumps

Each node displays an instant health dot badge reflecting the worst child asset state. Clicking any equipment node immediately mounts that asset into the active workspace. The sidebar can be collapsed to an 56px icon rail via `[` or mouse toggle.

---

### 4. Contextual Tab Bar for Asset Deep-Dive Views

When navigating within any asset context (`/assets/:assetId/*`), a persistent sub-navigation tab bar displays below the breadcrumb, allowing seamless transitions without losing equipment context:
1. **Health Summary** (`/assets/:assetId/health-summary`): Overview of composite Asset Health Index, sensor trend sparks, multivariate anomaly attribution bars, and operating envelope limits.
2. **Diagnostics & Failure Fingerprints** (`/assets/:assetId/diagnostics`): Diagnostic classifier probabilities, automated root-cause failure signatures, and engineering sign-off records.
3. **Spectral Workbench** (`/assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics`): Full-screen FFT spectrum analysis, harmonic markers (1X, 2X, 3X), bearing fault overlays (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF), 3D waterfall plots, and orbit visualization.

---

### 5. Role-Specific Navigation Paths & Entry Points

#### Reliability Engineer (`reliability_engineer`)
- **Default Entry Route:** `/fleet-overview`
- **Primary Daily Nav Path:** `/fleet-overview` -> `/assets/:assetId/health-summary` -> `/prescriptive-advisories`
- **Quick Links:** CDU, FCC, Hydrocracker unit filters; active anomaly queue; unacknowledged alert drawer.

#### Rotating Equipment Specialist (`machinery_specialist`)
- **Default Entry Route:** `/assets/P-101A/spectral-analytics` (or active diagnostic triage item)
- **Primary Deep-Dive Nav Path:** `/assets/:assetId/diagnostics` -> `/assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics` -> `/model-management/retraining` -> `/model-management/evaluation`
- **Specialist Tools:** Bearing defect frequency overlay selectors, waterfall timeline scrubber, multi-tag historian trend comparison, model baseline recalibration workbench.

#### Maintenance Planner (`maintenance_planner`)
- **Default Entry Route:** `/prescriptive-advisories`
- **Primary Dispatch Nav Path:** `/prescriptive-advisories` -> `/work-orders/confirmation`
- **Planning Views:** P-F interval timelines, spare seal/bearing stock verification widgets, one-click SAP PM / IBM Maximo payload generators.

#### Plant Operations Superintendent (`operations_superintendent`)
- **Default Entry Route:** `/operations/unit-risk-matrix`
- **Operational Nav Path:** `/operations/unit-risk-matrix` -> `/operations/shift-log` -> `/fleet-overview`
- **Operational Tools:** Unit production derating matrix, cross-unit trip risk forecast, DCS console shift handover notes.

#### System Administrator (`admin`)
- **Default Entry Route:** `/admin/historian-connections`
- **Governance Nav Path:** `/admin/historian-connections` -> `/admin/tag-mapping` -> `/admin/asset-hierarchy-builder` -> `/admin/security-audit` -> `/admin/system-health`
- **Admin Tools:** Local LDAP/AD user access mapping, time-series buffer health, IEC 62443 audit export, on-prem database disk volume monitoring.

---

### 6. Industrial Keyboard Navigation Shortcuts

To maximize efficiency during high-stress operational reviews, RefineGuard APM provides direct keyboard control:

| Keystroke | Scope | Action |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `Cmd/Ctrl + K` | Global | Open Asset & Historian Tag Quick Switcher Modal |
| `[` | Global | Toggle Collapse / Expand ISA-95 Hierarchy Sidebar |
| `1` - `4` | Fleet Overview | Quick filter by Operating Unit (1: CDU, 2: FCC, 3: HCU, 4: ALKY) |
| `A` / `Space` | Asset View | Acknowledge active anomaly alert / Open triage drawer |
| `J` / `K` | Asset List / Tree | Navigate down / up asset rows |
| `Enter` | Asset List / Tree | Open currently highlighted asset |
| `H` | Spectral Workbench | Toggle Harmonic Peak Overlay Markers (1X, 2X, 3X... harmonics) |
| `B` | Spectral Workbench | Toggle Bearing Kinematic Defect Markers (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF) |
| `W` | Spectral Workbench | Toggle 2D Spectrum vs 3D Waterfall Visualization |
| `Left` / `Right` | Spectral Waterfall | Scrub historical time slices forward / backward |
| `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter`| Prescriptive View| Confirm and Dispatch Work Order to CMMS (SAP PM / Maximo) |
| `Esc` | Modal / Drawer | Close active modal, drawer, or cancel selection |

Only admin can access /admin/historian-connections to modify connection endpoints, credentials, or polling schedules.

user_stories.title: US-04: Refinery Fleet Health Dashboard & Unit Filtering [Must Have, 8 pts]

user_story.i_want: to view refinery-wide rotating machinery health on a unified dashboard with quick unit filters and ISO 10816 vibration severity cards
user_story.so_that: I can triage 20-50 critical assets within minutes during morning operational reviews and prioritize degrading equipment

user_stories.key_feature: Multivariate Anomaly Detection & Health Index Engine
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated session, when navigating to /fleet-overview, the dashboard displays global KPI tallies (Total Monitored, Normal, Alert, Alarm, Trip) and unit-level health distributions across CDU and FCC within 500ms.
Filtering by refinery operating unit (e.g., Crude Distillation Unit CDU-1) filters the asset card grid instantly without page reload.
Each equipment card displays current Asset Health Index (0-100), ISO 10816 vibration severity category (Good, Satisfactory, Unsatisfactory, Unacceptable), and 24-hour health trend sparkline.
Clicking an equipment card redirects the user to /assets/:assetId/health-summary with that asset's contextual telemetry pre-loaded.
Only reliability_engineer, machinery_specialist, maintenance_planner, operations_superintendent, and admin can access /fleet-overview.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /fleet-overview.
The data model stores severity weight and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: US-05: Real-Time Multivariate Anomaly Scoring & Sensor Attribution [Must Have, 8 pts]

user_story.i_want: to inspect continuous multivariate anomaly scores and sensor attribution rankings on anomalous machines
user_story.so_that: I can pinpoint which specific vibration, temperature, or process variables deviate from learned normal baselines

user_stories.key_feature: Multivariate Anomaly Detection & Health Index Engine
acceptance_criteria: Given an asset flagged in Alert or Alarm state, when navigating to /assets/:assetId/health-summary, the system renders the composite Asset Health Index (0-100) and top contributing sensor tags ranked by percentage contribution.
When the reliability engineer acknowledges an anomaly on /assets/:assetId/health-summary, the alert status updates to 'Under Investigation', capturing user timestamp and ID in the audit record.
If an asset's multivariate reconstruction error exceeds the 99th percentile threshold for 3 consecutive 1-minute intervals, the health state transitions from Normal to Alert automatically.
Only reliability_engineer, machinery_specialist, maintenance_planner, and operations_superintendent can access /assets/:assetId/health-summary.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /assets/:assetId/health-summary.

user_stories.title: US-06: Air-Gapped Local Active Directory Authentication & Session Security [Must Have, 5 pts]

user_story.i_want: to log in using air-gapped corporate domain credentials via local Active Directory/LDAP with hardware security tokens
user_story.so_that: refinery OT personnel securely access the APM platform without external internet connectivity

acceptance_criteria: Given valid local Active Directory credentials and hardware token, when submitted at /login, the user is authenticated and redirected to /fleet-overview with role-appropriate permissions.
When invalid credentials or an expired token are submitted, the login view displays an authentication failure banner and locks the account after 5 consecutive failed attempts.
Guest users can view the login screen at /login without an account, but cannot access any protected routes.
User sessions automatically terminate after 30 minutes of inactivity, requiring re-authentication.
Unauthenticated users attempting to access /fleet-overview or /assets are redirected to /login with their target return URL preserved.
The authentication service functions entirely offline with zero outbound network requests outside the local air-gapped DMZ.

user_stories.title: US-07: Tamper-Evident Audit Logging & On-Premises System Telemetry [Must Have, 5 pts]

user_story.i_want: to monitor local bare-metal / Kubernetes cluster health and inspect tamper-evident audit logs
user_story.so_that: the air-gapped platform maintains continuous reliability and complies with IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards

acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /admin/system-health displays local time-series database disk utilization, ingestion buffer backlog, and local backup status with visual warning indicators when storage exceeds 80%.
Every authentication attempt, role escalation, baseline retraining, and CMMS dispatch event is recorded in an immutable, append-only audit log viewable at /admin/security-audit.
Admins can export signed tamper-evident compliance audit logs in JSON and CSV format directly from /admin/security-audit.
Only admin can access /admin/security-audit and /admin/system-health.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /admin/security-audit or /admin/system-health.

user_stories.title: US-08: Automated Failure Mode Diagnostic Classification & Fingerprinting [Must Have, 8 pts]

user_story.i_want: an automated diagnostic classifier that maps spectral peaks, harmonics, and process signatures to specific failure modes (unbalance, misalignment, bearing race defects, seal flush loss, cavitation)
user_story.so_that: I can immediately identify the underlying physical mechanical fault without manual kinematic calculations

acceptance_criteria: Given anomalous vibration data for an asset, when opening /assets/:assetId/diagnostics, the diagnostic classifier displays calculated fault probabilities (e.g., 'Bearing Outer Race Defect BPFO: 89%') alongside ISO 10816 baseline thresholds.
The classifier differentiates between hydraulic cavitation (broadband noise floor rise between 1 kHz and 5 kHz) and bearing defect harmonics (discrete non-synchronous peaks at BPFO or BPFI).

When the specialist confirms or edits a diagnostic finding (e.g., 'Stage 2 Bearing Outer Race Spall'), the finding is recorded with technical notes and propagates to prescriptive maintenance planning.
Only reliability_engineer, machinery_specialist, and maintenance_planner can access /assets/:assetId/diagnostics.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /assets/:assetId/diagnostics.

user_stories.title: US-09: Interactive FFT Spectral Workbench & Bearing Defect Overlays [Must Have, 8 pts]

user_story.i_want: an interactive vibration workbench displaying high-resolution FFT spectra, harmonic markers (1X, 2X, 3X), sideband cursors, and bearing kinematic defect overlays (BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF)
user_story.so_that: I can confirm specific mechanical degradation frequencies and sidebands on rotating assets

acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics renders high-frequency FFT acceleration and velocity spectra within 500ms for up to 64k-line resolutions.
Toggling bearing geometry overlays calculates and overlays BPFO, BPFI, BSF, and FTF frequency lines automatically based on ISO 14224 bearing model metadata and current shaft RPM.
Users can place interactive harmonic cursors (1X through 10X) and sideband cursors (pole pass, running speed) with real-time delta frequency and amplitude readouts.
Only reliability_engineer and machinery_specialist can access /assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics.

user_stories.title: US-10: 3D Spectral Waterfall Plots & Process Variable Synchronized Trending [Should Have, 5 pts]

The multi-tag correlation view synchronizes vibration overall RMS, motor amps, suction pressure, and bearing temperature on a unified time axis with crosshair zoom.

user_stories.title: US-11: Degradation Trajectory Modeling & Remaining Useful Life Estimation [Must Have, 8 pts]

The prognostic model dynamically recalculates the RUL trajectory whenever operational process load or vibration RMS exceeds the rolling 7-day average by >15%.
When the estimated RUL reaches <=14 days, the advisory status automatically escalates to 'Urgent Action Required' and dispatches high-priority system alerts.

target_audience.name: Reliability Engineer
pain_points: Overwhelmed by thousands of uncontextualized historian tags
Lack of automated anomaly detection inside the air-gapped OT network
Time lost manually compiling vibration and temperature trends across spreadsheets
target_audience.demographics: Certified machinery reliability engineers (CMRP/CRE) with 5-15 years refinery experience, responsible for rotating equipment health across crude distillation, FCC, hydrocracker, and alkylation units.
needs_and_goals: Detect early mechanical degradation weeks before catastrophic failure
Eliminate false positive alarms and alarm fatigue from DCS thresholds
Prioritize maintenance interventions based on quantitative asset health scoring
Correlate vibration signatures with process variables like suction head and flow

target_audience.name: Rotating Equipment Specialist
pain_points: Legacy condition monitoring tools have clunky, sluggish interfaces and poor historian integration
Inability to overlay historical baseline spectrums against current anomaly states
Manual diagnostic calculation is tedious and prone to human oversight during plant upsets
target_audience.demographics: Vibration analysts (ISO 18436 Category III/IV) and rotating machinery subject matter experts specializing in turbomachinery, mechanical seals, and dynamic balancing.
needs_and_goals: Inspect detailed FFT spectrums, waterfalls, orbits, and Bode plots quickly
Differentiate process-induced cavitation from mechanical bearing defect frequencies (BPFO/BPFI)
Validate asset operating limits against API 610, API 617, and ISO 10816 standards
Fine-tune ML anomaly baselines following mechanical overhauls or impellor changes

target_audience.name: Maintenance Planner
pain_points: Emergency repairs caused by unexpected failures disrupt scheduled work schedules
Incomplete technical notes in legacy alerts cause delays in ordering long-lead spare parts
Uncertainty regarding remaining useful life forces conservative, costly equipment swaps
target_audience.demographics: Maintenance leads and planning coordinators responsible for daily work orders, turnaround planning, spare parts staging, and craft scheduling.
needs_and_goals: Receive clear prescriptive failure summaries and lead-time estimations
Integrate actionable diagnostic alerts directly into SAP PM or IBM Maximo work orders
Verify spare seal cartridges, bearings, and motor inventory before scheduling outages
Optimize turnaround scopes by eliminating unnecessary open-and-inspect overhauls

target_audience.name: Plant Operations Superintendent

steps.description: Navigates to /login, authenticates via local air-gapped Active Directory credentials with hardware security key, and lands on /fleet-overview.
Reviews the global fleet status KPI strip (242 Assets Monitored, 218 Normal, 19 Alert, 4 Alarm, 1 Trip) and uses unit quick-filter to isolate Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-1).
Spots Crude Charge Pump P-101A flagged in 'Alarm' state with an Asset Health Index drop from 94 to 61 over the preceding 48 hours.
Clicks P-101A card or presses 'Enter' to navigate to /assets/P-101A/health-summary to examine multivariate sensor telemetry.
Inspects the Anomaly Attribution panel, observing that outboard bearing radial vibration (tag: 101_VIB_OB_R) and drive-end bearing temperature (tag: 101_TI_DE) account for 84% of the anomaly score.
Acknowledges the active alarm, changes investigation state to 'Under Investigation', assigns diagnostic deep-dive to Rotating Equipment Specialist Dr. Elena Rostova, and inputs triage notes.

user_journeys.context: Marcus Vance performs his routine morning fleet triage across 240+ refinery rotating assets, identifying an incipient bearing degradation on Crude Distillation Unit charge pump P-101A.
user_journeys.trigger: Shift handover begins at 06:45; Marcus logs into the morning engineering console to evaluate overnight asset health anomalies before the 07:15 cross-functional operations standup.

steps.description: Navigates directly to /assets/P-101A/diagnostics and reviews the automated Diagnostic Classifier card indicating 'High Probability (89%) Bearing Outer Race Defect (BPFO)'.
Navigates to /assets/P-101A/spectral-analytics to inspect high-frequency vibration acceleration and velocity FFT spectra.
Toggles the ISO 14224 bearing geometry overlay (SKF 7314 BECBM), activating automated kinematic markers for BPFO (3.57X), BPFI (5.43X), BSF (2.32X), and FTF (0.41X).
Identifies distinct, elevated non-synchronous peaks at 106.8 Hz (matching BPFO at 1,795 RPM shaft speed) with 1X running speed sidebands indicating early spalling on the outer raceway.
Switches to 3D Waterfall view over the past 30 days to verify degradation trajectory, noting that defect energy emerged 9 days ago and accelerated following a brief process cavitation surge.
Correlates vibration signatures against suction pressure (tag: 101_PI_SUCT) and motor amps (tag: 101_II_MTR) in the multi-tag synchronized trend view.
Saves and signs off the diagnostic finding as 'Stage 2 Bearing Outer Race Spall - Outboard Bearing', recommending bearing assembly replacement within 18-21 days and notifying Maintenance Planning.

user_journeys.context: Dr. Elena Rostova conducts an advanced spectral diagnostic investigation on CDU Charge Pump P-101A to isolate the exact mechanical root cause and validate degradation severity.
user_journeys.trigger: Elena receives an internal triage assignment notification from Marcus regarding the sudden vibration spike and thermal rise on P-101A.

steps.description: Navigates to /prescriptive-advisories and opens the active advisory card for P-101A (Advisory ADV-2024-0891).

Reviews the Prognostics & RUL panel displaying an estimated P-F interval window of 18 days (confidence interval: 14 to 22 days at current operating load) before vibration reaches ISO Zone D trip threshold.
Examines the system-generated recommended action: 'Replace Outboard Angular Contact Bearing Pair (SKF 7314 BECBM) and inspect Plan 11 seal flush piping'.
Checks the integrated on-prem warehouse inventory widget, verifying that two SKF 7314 bearing sets and one Flowserve cartridge seal kit are in stock at Refinery Central Warehouse Bin C-14.
Sets maintenance priority to 'Priority 2 - Urgent (Within 7 Days)', attaches the automated diagnostic summary and FFT spectral snapshot, and clicks 'Dispatch Work Order'.
System generates work order #WO-884210 in the air-gapped SAP PM connector and redirects Dave to /work-orders/confirmation with synched SAP order status and reservation codes.

user_journeys.context: Dave Kalu reviews the validated diagnostic advisory for P-101A, assesses component lead times against RUL, verifies warehouse inventory, and dispatches a prioritized CMMS work package.
user_journeys.trigger: Elena signs off on the Stage 2 bearing defect finding, triggering an automated high-priority prescriptive maintenance advisory.

features: Multivariate Anomaly Detection & Health Index Engine
phasing.rationale: Target Timeline: Months 1-4. Establishes the core air-gapped platform architecture, high-frequency industrial data connectors (OSIsoft PI System / AVEVA PI AF, Honeywell PHD), ISO 14224 asset digital twin modeling, and unsupervised multivariate anomaly detection for an initial pilot cohort of 20-50 critical rotating machines (Crude Charge Pumps, FCC Wet Gas Compressors, Coker Feed Pumps) across CDU and FCC units. Key deliverables include /login with local AD/LDAP, /fleet-overview with dynamic Asset Health Index (0-100), /admin tag configuration and health monitoring, and IEC 62443 air-gapped security governance. Prerequisites: Purdue Level 3 historian read-access, network provisioning in DMZ, and ISO 14224 equipment taxonomies. Success criteria: Zero data loss under network jitter, sub-second telemetry ingestion latency, >95% anomaly capture on seeded historical fault replays, and zero outbound network packet leakage.

Target Timeline: Months 5-8. Delivers deep vibration diagnostic capabilities and interactive spectral visualization tailored for Level III/IV vibration specialists (Dr. Elena Rostova). Features automated kinematic fault fingerprinting for common rotating equipment failure modes (bearing outer/inner race spall BPFO/BPFI, unbalance 1X, misalignment 2X, impeller vane pass, cavitation) and a high-performance vibration workbench (/assets/:assetId/spectral-analytics and /assets/:assetId/diagnostics) featuring interactive FFT spectra, harmonic cursors, 3D waterfall plots, and multi-sensor correlation. Prerequisites: Phase 1 calibrated baseline streams, bearing kinematic geometry database (SKF, FAG, Timken), and raw vibration waveform access. Success criteria: Automated diagnosis accuracy ≥90% validated against historical plant turnaround teardown reports, and sub-500ms spectrum rendering for 64k-line FFT datasets.

Target Timeline: Months 9-12. Expands the platform refinery-wide across Hydrocracker, Alkylation, and Utilities units (200+ rotating trains), delivering remaining useful life (RUL) trajectory projections, prescriptive mitigation advisories, bidirectional CMMS work order generation (SAP PM / IBM Maximo), and operations superintendent risk matrices. Features include /prescriptive-advisories, /work-orders/confirmation, /operations/unit-risk-matrix, and automated air-gapped model recalibration workflows post-overhaul. Prerequisites: Phase 2 diagnostic sign-offs, CMMS API connectivity in DMZ, and operations shift log hooks. Success criteria: Accurate RUL lead time estimation within ±15% of actual P-F interval, >80% reduction in unplanned rotating equipment trip events, and 100% automated population of diagnostic evidence in CMMS work notifications.
